validated_results.title: The Gut-Prostate Axis: Decoding the Interplay of Environmental Factors, Microbial Metabolites, and Hormonal Regulation in Prostate Cancer Pathogenesis.
validated_results.reason: The article is explicitly a narrative review of the gut-prostate axis ("In this review we present the current knowledge on gut-prostate axis") rather than an original human study of probiotics and prostate cancer incidence.

validated_results.title: Vitamin D deficiency alters prostate epithelial differentiation and increases prostate cancer aggressiveness in ex vivo and in vivo models.
validated_results.journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
validated_results.reason: Vitamin D deficiency was studied exclusively in mouse prostate organoids, mice fed deficient diets, and human cell-line xenografts, with no human incidence data.

validated_results.title: Erythropoietin drug targets and cancer risk: A two-sample Mendelian randomization study.
validated_results.reason: The report uses Mendelian randomization or genetic instruments, which this protocol excludes.

validated_results.title: Long-term associations between animal-source food consumption and breast and prostate cancer incidence based on cointegration and ARIMAX models.
validated_results.reason: Dairy consumption was collapsed with meat consumption into a single principal-component index (PC1) used as the exposure, so no dairy-specific estimate for prostate cancer incidence is separable.

validated_results.title: Empirically derived dietary patterns and prostate cancer risk: a systematic review and meta-analysis of prospective cohorts.
validated_results.journal: European journal of cancer prevention : the official journal of the European Cancer Prevention Organisation (ECP)
validated_results.reason: This is a systematic review and meta-analysis of prospective cohorts of dietary patterns, not an original human study.

validated_results.title: Empirically derived dietary patterns and prostate cancer risk: a systematic review and meta-analysis of prospective cohorts.
validated_results.journal: European journal of cancer prevention : the official journal of the European Cancer Prevention Organisation (ECP)
validated_results.reason: The publication pools hazard ratios from six cohorts in a PRISMA-guided systematic review and meta-analysis rather than reporting primary data.

validated_results.title: A Rapid and Versatile Colorimetric Sensor for the Visual Detection of Zinc Ions in Urine and Drinking Water.
validated_results.reason: The study develops and validates a colorimetric sensor for detecting zinc ions in urine and drinking water, providing analytical performance rather than evidence on developing prostate cancer.

validated_results.title: Effects of daily multivitamin-multimineral supplementation on metabolomic profiles: 2-year findings from the COSMOS randomized clinical trial.
validated_results.reason: Docosahexaenoic acid appears only as a metabolite outcome of multivitamin-multimineral supplementation, not as an exposure evaluated against prostate cancer occurrence.

validated_results.title: Effects of daily multivitamin-multimineral supplementation on metabolomic profiles: 2-year findings from the COSMOS randomized clinical trial.
validated_results.reason: The trial reports effects of multivitamin supplementation on metabolomic risk scores and aging clocks, not on incident prostate cancer.

validated_results.title: Effects of daily multivitamin-multimineral supplementation on metabolomic profiles: 2-year findings from the COSMOS randomized clinical trial.
validated_results.reason: Omega-3 fatty acid concentrations are measured as a metabolomic outcome of multivitamin supplementation rather than as an exposure related to prostate cancer incidence.

validated_results.title: Prostate cancer: metabolic remodelling in expressed prostatic secretions reveals cellular structural changes measured by mpMRI.
validated_results.reason: Myo-inositol is assessed as a discriminative metabolite in expressed prostatic secretions for distinguishing prostate cancer from benign hyperplasia, a diagnostic biomarker analysis without incidence evidence.
